# That's the Spot Massage Therapy

> Private, single-therapist massage studio in Corpus Christi, Texas. Personalized Swedish and deep-tissue massage with George Alvarado, Licensed Massage Therapist (Texas License #MT149213). One client at a time — no spa crowds, no upsells. Slogan: "A great massage at a great price."

## Key facts

- Location: 3765 S Alameda St, Suite 305, Corpus Christi, TX 78411 (private studio)
- Phone (call or text): (361) 373-9592
- Email: georgealvarado2790@yahoo.com
- Hours: Open 7 days a week, 7:00 AM – 10:00 PM, by appointment only
- Booking: https://thatsthespot.glossgenius.com/services (instant online booking with live availability)
- Therapist: George Alvarado, LMT — Texas License #MT149213 (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation)
- Payment: pay online or in person; Buy Now, Pay Later available at checkout for eligible bookings
- Clientele: adults; minors only with a parent or legal guardian present
- Mobile / in-home massage: available — add the travel fee to any service when booking ($25 in Corpus Christi, $50 outside)

## Services & prices (transparent, no hidden fees)

- Swedish Massage — 50 minutes: $55

- Foot Massage — 20 minutes: $25
- Stretch Session (focused on client-specific areas) — 15 minutes: $20
- Stretch Session (focused on client-specific areas) — 30 minutes: $40
- Hot Stone Add-On — add to any massage: +$20
- Mobile massage travel fee — $25 within Corpus Christi, $50 outside Corpus Christi

## What makes it different

- Every session is personalized: clients tell George their focus areas and preferred pressure (feather-light to firm) and the session is built around it
- Personalized welcome: your name on a lighted welcome board when you arrive
- Amenities: heated towels every session, chilled bottled water, aromatherapy diffuser, plush blankets, private room
- Direct access to the therapist by call or text — no front desk, no phone tree
